title: Awesome !!!!!
text:
We loved this visit! It is a must-see in Seville.

Once at the top, you walk on a walkway that winds along the top of the wooden structure and offers a 360° panoramic view of the entire city. It is an exceptional viewpoint that allows you to admire the rooftops of Seville and the whole city from a different angle.

The walk is very pleasant and is done quite quickly, which makes it a perfect activity to include in a day of sightseeing. At the end of the route, you discover a short immersive film about the history and heritage of Seville. It is a nice surprise that concludes the experience very
author: Caroline121990
